parts.text: Identify resource hubs and anchorages for 41.2835 N, 70.0995 W (Nantucket, MA). Radius 10 nm.

Recommend 15 anchorages, moorings, and marinas within 15 nm of 41.2835°N, 70.0995°W (Nantucket, MA). This is a day trip — a single-day outing with no overnight stay. Prioritize day-use anchorages, lunch stops, and moorings suited to a few hours rather than overnight-only spots.

Recommend anchorages, moorings, marinas, and fuel docks within 15 nm of center coordinates (latitude: 18.4207, longitude: -64.6399, 18.4207°N, 64.6399°W; center reference point near Tortola, British Virgin Islands). Classify each recommendation with voyage_role ('start_end_base', 'overnight_stop', 'day_stop', or 'service_only') and stay_details. Ensure Tortola charter fleet bases (Road Town / Wickhams Cay, Nanny Cay, and Hodges Creek / Parham Town / East End) are identified as 'start_end_base' with charter_companies populated, while out-island and resort stopover marinas (such as Scrub Island, Virgin Gorda, Norman Island, Peter Island, Cooper Island, and Soper's Hole) are classified as 'overnight_stop'.

Recommend anchorages, moorings, marinas, and fuel docks within 20 nm of center coordinates (latitude: 38.9784, longitude: -76.4922, 38.9784°N, 76.4922°W; center reference point near Annapolis, MD, Chesapeake Bay). Classify each recommendation with voyage_role ('start_end_base', 'overnight_stop', 'day_stop', or 'service_only') and stay_details. Ensure only verified commercial charter fleet bases (such as Annapolis / Eastport and Rock Hall) are classified as 'start_end_base', while overnight destination harbors and creek marinas (such as St. Michaels, Galesville, Deale, and Kent Island) are classified as 'overnight_stop'.

Recommend anchorages, moorings, marinas, and fuel docks within 36 nm of center coordinates (latitude: 41.5294, longitude: -70.9597, 41.5294°N, 70.9597°W; center reference point near Dartmouth, Massachusetts, United States (including Newport)). IMPORTANT: "Dartmouth, Massachusetts, United States (including Newport)" is only the nearest point to the circle center — the search circle spans 36 nm in ALL directions (N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW) across multiple shores, harbors, and rivers. Identify every commercial yacht charter embarkation base across ALL major yachting harbors inside the search circle (including Newport, RI on the western side and Padanaram / South Dartmouth in Buzzards Bay) as voyage_role="start_end_base" with stay_details.is_charter_base=true and stay_details.charter_companies populated, while offshore islands and stopover harbors (such as Block Island / Great Salt Pond / New Shoreham, Cuttyhunk, Martha's Vineyard, Hadley Harbor, Dutch Island, Jamestown, and Menemsha) are classified as 'overnight_stop' with is_charter_base=false.
